items.title: Loren Schoenberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: Eddie Jones was about six feet — he could have been a football player — like six foot six, big guy.

ctx.x: Not the bassist. Eddie Jones was about six feet — he could have been a football player — like six foot six, big guy. Somebody comes and taps him on the shoulder and takes the bass. It’s Charles Mingus. And I recorded this on my little tape. I gave it to Phil Schaap, I never saw it again, but I’m just joking because Phil gave it back to me thirty years later.
